description: Figure: Rac2-null mouse recapitulates all six core IMD73C features, with the mechanistic causal chain
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

cols=["Impaired neutrophil\nchemotaxis","Decreased total\nB cell count\nHP:0010976","Decreased\ncirculating IgG\nHP:0004315",
      "Decreased\ncirculating IgM\nHP:0002850","Low TRECs /\nreduced T cells\nHP:0031545","Susceptibility to\nbacterial infection\nHP:0002205"]
dat={"Rac2":[1,1,1,1,1,1],"Dock2":[1,1,1,0,1,0],"Itgb2":[0,1,1,0,1,1],"Rag1":[0,1,1,1,1,0],
     "Il2rg":[0,0,1,1,1,0],"Was":[0,1,0,0,1,0],"Btk":[0,1,0,1,0,0],"Rac1":[1,0,0,0,0,0],
     "Ncf1":[0,0,0,0,0,1],"Cybb":[0,0,0,0,0,1],"Ada":[0,0,0,0,1,0],"Dock8":[0,0,0,0,0,0]}
M=pd.DataFrame(dat, index=cols).T

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(15.8,6.4), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.5,1]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.imshow(M.values, cmap="Blues", vmin=0, vmax=1.35, aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(M.shape[1])); ax.set_xticklabels(M.columns, fontsize=7.6)
ax.set_yticks(range(M.shape[0])); ax.set_yticklabels(M.index, fontsize=10)
ax.get_yticklabels()[0].set_color("#C03221"); ax.get_yticklabels()[0].set_weight("bold")
for i in range(M.shape[0]):
    for j in range(M.shape[1]):
        if M.values[i,j]: ax.text(j,i,"✓",ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=13,weight="bold")
for k,v in enumerate(M.sum(axis=1)):
    ax.text(M.shape[1]-0.35, k, f"  {v}/6", va="center", fontsize=9,
            color="#C03221" if k==0 else "#555", weight="bold" if k==0 else "normal")
ax.set_title("A  Mouse-model recapitulation of six core IMD73C features\nRac2 6/6 vs mean 2.1/6 across 11 comparator inborn-error-of-immunity genes\n(Fisher exact, one-sided, p = 0.0030); source: Alliance of Genome Resources MP annotations",
             fontsize=9.8, loc="left", weight="bold")
ax.set_xlabel("human IMD73C feature, mapped to the mouse phenotype statement it predicts", fontsize=8.8)

ax=axes[1]; ax.axis("off")
steps=[("RAC2 c.167G>A p.Trp56Ter, homozygous\n(truncation before Switch II and before\nthe C-terminal polybasic/CAAX motif)","#C03221"),
       ("leads to loss of functional RAC2 protein in\nhaematopoietic cells; RAC1 is co-expressed\nbut does not fully compensate","#B5651D"),
       ("branch 1: RAC2-GTP cannot bind p67phox\n(NCF2) → NADPH oxidase (CYBB/CYBA/NCF1/\nNCF2/NCF4) not assembled → low superoxide","#1F6FB2"),
       ("branch 2: RAC2-GTP cannot engage PAK1/2 and\nWAVE2 (WASF2-CYFIP2-NCKAP1L) → no polarised\nlamellipodial F-actin → no directed migration","#2E7D32"),
       ("branch 3 (inferred from mouse): loss of\nDOCK2/VAV1 → RAC2 signalling in lymphocytes\n→ impaired T and B development and survival","#7B4FA8"),
       ("results in defective bacterial/fungal killing,\nabsent fMLP chemotaxis, low TRECs, low B cells,\nlow IgG and IgM","#5A5A66"),
       ("manifests as recurrent respiratory infection,\nfailure to thrive, lymphadenopathy, and\nautoimmune/renal involvement","#C03221")]
y=0.985
for i,(txt,c) in enumerate(steps):
    h=0.117
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.02,y-h),0.96,h, fc=c, alpha=0.13, ec=c, lw=1.3))
    ax.text(0.5,y-h/2,txt,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7.5,color=c,linespacing=1.3)
    if i<len(steps)-1:
        ax.annotate("", xy=(0.5,y-h-0.016), xytext=(0.5,y-h), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>",color="#999",lw=1.4))
    y-=h+0.016
ax.set_xlim(0,1); ax.set_ylim(0,1)
ax.set_title("B  IMD73C causal chain from mutation to clinical phenotype\nbranches 1-2 demonstrated in RAC2-mutant human neutrophils;\nbranch 3 inferred from Rac2-null mouse lymphocytes", fontsize=9.8, loc="left", weight="bold")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
